program: Wingless external raw-input to repaired prediction to fixed refined abstract reasoning attribution
question: Why does the fixed eight-class training-rank readout expose only part of the supported exact predictive gain at depth 3?
hypothesis: Without changing the sealed 512-motif representation, repaired relation, eight fixed 64-motif classes, runtime cap, horizons, or any learned/readout capacity, attribute every depth-3 query where repaired exact top-1 correctness differs from baseline into frozen categories: same refined class versus cross-class transition, repaired probability mass moved toward truth class versus away, source domain, and whether distributional class aggregation agrees with repaired top-1 projection. The residual hidden-gain population will be explained primarily by class-boundary geometry rather than transition prediction or probability aggregation: at least 0.75 of hidden exact-gain queries will be same-class under the eight-class readout, repaired truth-class mass will not decrease on more than 0.25 of hidden-gain queries, and source-specific hidden fractions will remain finite and explicitly reported.

prior_evidence.diagnosis: The fixed 8x64 readout exposes some predictive gain but leaves 80.33% of exact repair-gain queries hidden. The next bounded step is attribution only, not more readout capacity.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.refined_readout: byte-identical fixed eight training-rank classes of 64 motifs each

attribution_protocol.primary_population: all heldout depth-3 queries with repaired exact top-1 correctness different from baseline exact top-1 correctness
attribution_protocol.hidden_gain_population: queries where repaired exact top-1 becomes correct but refined class answer does not improve
categories: truth motif and repaired predicted motif in same refined class
truth motif and repaired predicted motif in different refined classes
repaired truth-class probability mass minus baseline truth-class probability mass
distributional refined answer agreement with repaired top-1 projection
attribution_protocol.selection_data: none; attribution is post hoc over frozen heldout scoring rows only

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes and both preregistered attribution thresholds pass, supporting class-boundary geometry as the primary residual bottleneck.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes but only one attribution threshold passes or source strata disagree materially.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but neither attribution threshold passes, rejecting class-boundary geometry as the primary residual bottleneck.
classification_rules.invalid: Any sealed-parent, authority, source, frozen-readout, accounting, determinism, capacity, or heldout-isolation criterion fails.

validity_criteria: Exact sealed mixed-result parent and North Star identities match.
Fresh READY_RESEARCH is bound to this exact preregistration and external manifest.
Representation, baseline relation, repaired relation, eight class assignments, support threshold, runtime cap, and horizons are unchanged.
Attribution introduces no learned state, adaptive thresholds, labels for selection, or additional readout capacity.
Heldout data is used only to score and categorize already-frozen predictions.
Duplicate complete probes are byte-identical and all attribution rows account exactly once.
No tokenizer, parser, external model, persistent corpus, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, split, representation, relation repair, class boundaries, runtime cap, horizons, attribution categories, 0.75 same-class floor, 0.25 mass-decrease ceiling, metrics, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: test one preregistered training-only boundary rule while keeping eight fixed classes and relation capacity unchanged

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: attribute residual failure to probability geometry/source specificity before any capacity change
